description:
In the WooCommerce admin panel, create two global product attributes and assign them to specific products.

1. Go to Products > Attributes and create:
   - Attribute: "Color" (slug: color). Terms: Black, White, Blue, Red, Green, Grey
   - Attribute: "Material" (slug: material). Terms: Cotton, Polyester, Denim, Wool, Leather

2. Edit the following existing products to assign these attributes:
   - "Organic Cotton T-Shirt": Set Color to "Black" and Material to "Cotton"
   - "Slim Fit Denim Jeans": Set Color to "Blue" and Material to "Denim"
   - "Merino Wool Sweater": Set Color to "Grey" and Material to "Wool"

IMPORTANT: For all product assignments, ensure the "Visible on the product page" checkbox is checked. Save each product after updating.
